fusions.name: Full-Draw Bolas
fusions.desc: After a 1 second draw, looses a weighted mesh that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its armour, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Three on a String
fusions.desc: Looses 3 shafts on cords at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and each kill hauls one back.

fusions.name: Tripline Shot
fusions.desc: Strings a drawn shaft to a tripline where you stand for 12 seconds. It shoots an enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds, each shot with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shooting the Snared
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
